lines.t: War drums in my chest when I open my eyes,
Steel in my voice when I step outside.
Line in the sand, we don’t compromise,
King at the gate, and He’s coming in fire.
Flood at my feet but the river splits,
Ark in the stream and the current quits.
Old heads marched on stone and brick,
Walls came down off a trumpet hit.
Now it’s spirit war, no stone and spear,
Same Holy One, but He’s drawing near.
This time hearts break, not just gates,
Whole world shaking under His weight.
Gird up your loins, better tighten that strap,
Hundred forty-four K with the seal on the cap.
This is war talk, not a feel-good track,
Make way for the King, no room to look back.
We don’t fold, we don’t flinch, we don’t crack,
Every step forward, whole hell pushed back.
Voice like thunder on a hard 808,
Prepare the way, the King’s at the gate.
Pride in the towers, blood in the streets,
Smoke in the sky, lies on repeat.
Whole earth drunk on violent dreams,
Every screen bent to blaspheme.
But there’s a code that the world can’t read,
Name on the heart no man can seize.
Called out, cut off, lives on the line,
Witnesses posted on enemy time.
We ain’t here for a stage or applause,
Whole life laid on the Altar of Yah.
One squad moving in one accord,
Every bar written like a drawn sword.
No mask on, this is raw, no cap,
Warrior praise over war-zone trap.
Either bow now or break when He lands,
Whole earth shaking in the King’s hands.
We don’t fold, we don’t flinch, we don’t crack,
Every step forward, whole hell pushed back.
Voice like thunder on a hard 808,
Prepare the way, the King’s at the gate.
Name in the forehead, flame in the chest,
Oath on the lips, no fear, no flex.
Run through fire, don’t break, don’t bend,
On this path, no turn, no trend.
We clean feet with a basin of grace,
Then swing truth in a serpent’s face.
Mercy in the left, judgment in the right,
Both hands move in the King’s pure light.
This ain’t cute, this the endgame script,
Last call going out over 808 kicks.
Idols fall when the word goes forth,
Whole grid black when He shakes this earth.
First fruits pulled from the filth and the stain,
Walk with the Lamb, no link in the chain.
No deceit in the verse, no fear in the voice,
Marked by fire, we already made the choice.
When the last bar drops and the sky goes split,
Every knee down, every crown gets stripped.
Rider on a white horse, robe in red,
Whole world silent when He tilts His head.
Gird up your loins, better tighten that strap,
Hundred forty-four K with the seal on the cap.
This is war talk, not a feel-good track,
Make way for the King, no room to look back.
We don’t fold, we don’t flinch, we don’t crack,
Every step forward, whole hell pushed back.
Voice like thunder on a hard 808,
Prepare the way, the King’s at the gate.
